svg.title: Mockup — Launcher · first run and action-bar states
svg.text: Launcher · first run — installing while the list stays usable
The action bar keeps its 72 px slot; nothing pretends to be a disabled “INSTALLING…” button

g.text: First run: Solaris is downloading what Minecraft 26.1.2 needs.
Select a server to see details. Double-click or Enter joins.

svg.text: Named stages, not a second bar
Bytes only where bytes are known
Unknown totals show the stage name
and no percentage, no sweeping bar.
Cancel is a real, neutral action
Canceled ≠ failed: no red, no ERROR.
Action-bar states (980×72; same slot, same height; the primary action is the only amber block)

g.text: Mojang client assets, a Java runtime and Solaris game data
No data received for 30 s. Download is still pending.

svg.text: Failed — summary + Retry; raw chain in Details

g.text: Could not reach the Solaris content server
Nothing new was installed. Check the address in Settings › Advanced, or retry.
Player on Solaris test · closing the launcher keeps the game running
